acts.desc: Producer Miki Meek takes Ira back to her old high school in a town called Payson, Utah. They meet up with students who go above and beyond when asking dates out to school dances. Chickens, goats and burning trees are involved. (12 1/2 minutes)

Act One
acts.desc: A guy in Key West makes a series of grand gestures, each one more outrageous than the last. He goes so far that we need to say that this story, from Miki Meek, is not for kids. Ben Harrison, who appears in this story, is author of the book “ Undying Love.”
acts.title: Dr. Strangelove

acts.desc: Our producer David Kestenbaum spoke with some people who are in the grand gesture business: skywriters.
